assumptions.p_awake: Share of staff already awake when the first message comes (the rest wake between wake_from and wake_to).
assumptions.wake_from: Earliest wake-up time of a person who was asleep (venue time).
assumptions.wake_to: Latest wake-up time of a person who was asleep (venue time).
assumptions.reply_lag_min: Minutes from seeing a message to answering it, lower bound (uniform).
assumptions.reply_lag_max: Minutes from seeing a message to answering it, upper bound (uniform).
assumptions.p_willing_role: Chance that a free person who holds the shift's role wants the shift that morning.
assumptions.p_willing_other: Chance that a free person without the shift's role still answers 'I can come' in the chat.
assumptions.manager_notice_minutes: Minutes from a call-out (or a plan B card) to the manager seeing it at dawn.
assumptions.chat_post_minutes: Minutes the manager spends writing one post in the staff chat.
assumptions.chat_wait_minutes: Minutes the manager waits for the chat before starting to phone people.
assumptions.call_minutes: Minutes per phone call: dialing, ringing, voicemail or a short talk.
assumptions.p_pickup_awake: Chance that an awake person picks up the manager's call.
assumptions.p_pickup_asleep: Chance that a sleeping person is woken by the call and picks up.
assumptions.confirm_minutes: Minutes the manager spends confirming the person or deciding the fallback.
assumptions.intake_minutes: Minutes from the call-out to the first offer in CoachCover (voice to text to case).
assumptions.decide_minutes: Minutes the manager spends on a plan B card after seeing it.
assumptions.callouts_weights: Chance of 1, 2 or 3 call-outs on one morning.
assumptions.callout_to: Latest call-out time (venue time); every call-out comes before 06:00.
assumptions.callout_lead_minutes: A call-out comes at least this many minutes before the person's first shift.
assumptions.morning_until: Shifts of the absent person that start before this time need cover.
assumptions.card_changes: How many people get one card moved to expire around the morning (min, max).
assumptions.card_offset_days: Range of the new expiry date, in days from the morning (min, max).
assumptions.p_card_expired: Share of moved cards that expire before the morning.
assumptions.p_card_on_the_day: Share of moved cards that expire on the morning itself (allowed, with a warning).
assumptions.p_card_unconfirmed: Chance that one card's two readings disagree and nobody has confirmed it yet.
assumptions.hours_changes: How many people get extra hours this week (min, max).
assumptions.hours_target: Their weekly total after the extra hours, before any cover (min, max); the limit is the policy's.
assumptions.rota_swaps: How many of the morning's lessons are handed to another cleared instructor (min, max).
assumptions.p_renewal_overdue: Chance that one instructor's program renewal is overdue that week.
assumptions.p_family_yes: Assumed, not measured: chance that a private lesson's family says yes to another coach (and, asked again, to a new time with their own coach).
assumptions.p_family_no: Assumed, not measured: chance that the family says no; the rest do not answer in time.
assumptions.family_lag_min: Assumed, not measured: minutes from the question to the family's answer, lower bound (uniform).
assumptions.family_lag_max: Assumed, not measured: minutes from the question to the family's answer, upper bound (uniform).

baseline_manager_checks_role.text: Baseline where the manager takes only people who hold the shift's role (job title); cards, programs, hours and the group norm are still not checked.

coachcover_one_offer_at_a_time.text: CoachCover before 2026-11-07: one offer at a time, plan B only when the queue is empty (the 'before' column of the before/after table).

before_after.before: one offer at a time, plan B when the queue is empty
before_after.after: waves of 3, highest yes in 60 s, plan B 20 min before the start
